native_date_validation.scope: Native Date schema validation at full TimeClip boundaries, malformed calendar components, invalid zero dates, nested array abort behavior, raw failed outputs and default/factory/config schema issue fields. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

native_union.scope: Type-changing native union candidate selection, original inputs for aggregate failures, empty/single/multiple/mixed branches, transformations/fallbacks, nested array/map/set/struct raw outputs and nested generic struct callback compilation, callback traces, recursive issues, abort settings and factory/config messages. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

numeric_representation.scope: Native signed/unsigned widths including isize/usize, narrow JSON numeric alternatives, checks/conversions/messages, native precision boundaries, boxed equality, JSON adapters and primitive hooks. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

partial_equality.scope: Native scalar widths, NaN/signed zero and composite value equality in mixed failed sets/maps; explicit object interning models native value equality, with all abort settings.

cache_identity_audit.scope: Forty cache observations across four identified message callback identity scenarios.

raw_output_audit.scope: Type-changing failed outputs, invalid dates, skipped transformations and nested native partial collection/struct snapshots. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

entry_map_audit.scope: Arbitrary object keys, explicit identity/equality, transformed collisions in typed and raw output, exact path keys and abort behavior.

native_value.scope: Date and bigint equality, bounds and memberships with full issue fields; extended ISO years and arbitrary integer precision. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

dynamic_set.scope: Deterministic mixed JSON scalar sets, numeric representation equality, NaN, infinities, insertion order and signed zero.

custom_check.scope: Partial readiness, array wildcard paths, empty selections, guard kinds, canonical issues and all abort/message settings. Arrays-as-objects differences are tracked by exact json_object_boundary case IDs and native V callback regressions.

error_path.scope: Dot paths, flatten groups, empty/unsupported keys and error summaries; native prototype-free map projection.

action.scope: Full validation issue fields and UTF-16 fragments; factory/config messages. Word comparisons exclude Japanese/Thai dictionary tailoring; native tests cover those counts. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

boolean_config.scope: Custom truthy/falsy lists, Unicode normalization and SameValueZero scalar equality.

conversion.scope: String conversions, Unicode boolean lists and complete transformation issue fields. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

forward.scope: Forwarded paths and existing issue paths. Exact case tags separate native presence-based map/index traversal from legacy truthiness and missing-path exceptions.

message_context.scope: Message precedence, callback counts and issue metadata for both languages and all abort settings.

native_collection.scope: Native array/set/map/record partial outputs, errors, flattening and abort behavior.

pipeline.scope: Raw callback datasets, typed state, issue accumulation and transformation boundaries.

number.scope: Exact binary64 rounding bits, subnormals, overflow, radix boundaries and 8192 seeded floating inputs. Reviewed native text-policy differences are reported by explicit case ID.
